interpretation: A useful retrieval movement does not make hypothetical claims true.
Mean first-relevant rank is not comparable without noting changed found-question membership.
Equal fusion protects baseline relevance but eliminates all observed HyDE gains.
Drift diagnostics are audit signals, not calibrated predictors of retrieval outcome.
A smaller generator would address latency but not the absence of fused retrieval benefit.
